status: DRAFT, written for review. No model is trained, no GPU is used, and nothing in this file has been executed as an experiment

feature_space.correction: the brief asked for "the 23-dimensional cue plus estimated SNR plus channel type". That double-counts: the 23 dimensions are already 21 perception fields plus the 2 channel fields ['est_snr_db', 'channel_is_rayleigh']. The input is 21 + 2 = 23, not 25
feature_space.point_source: get_item_single_car()['projected_lidar'] for the EGO CAV ONLY -- the same array pre_processor.preprocess() receives, so the cue describes exactly the scene action E sees. projected_lidar_stack is never built.

data.split_rule: validate only. test and Culver are not touched at any point in this plan, including for model selection

headline_potential.reading: these are the offline potentials from offline_potential.md. They bound what any predictor could recover and are the reason this plan is worth reviewing at all

C7_label_rule.rule: a*_t = argmax_a Q_t(a) under the locked all-or-nothing message accounting, ties to the cheaper payload, TOL = 1e-09
C7_label_rule.fixed: this is the label definition and it does not change during the study
C7_label_rule.prefer_F_is_not_a_label: the idea that F should be preferred where the channel permits it is recorded as a research hypothesis to be tested, not as a labelling rule. It does not enter the targets
C7_label_rule.forcing_F_is_an_objective_change: any scheme that forces F on good-channel frames is a change of objective, not a tuning choice. It requires a separate discussion and a separate pre-registration before it may be tried

C8_interpretation_rule.what_is_reported: the trained selector's realised E/L/F request shares, printed beside the offline reference shares from offline_potential B-1, for the same subsets
C8_interpretation_rule.reading_1: F has limited opportunity under the current data and transmission model
C8_interpretation_rule.reading_2: the inputs or the fitting are insufficient, and the selector is what to examine
C8_interpretation_rule.forbidden: neither reading may be written as "F is useless", and neither is grounds for reverting to an E/L-only design. Both are statements about this data and this model, not about the action

C9_role_of_the_threshold_rule.status: the fixed channel-threshold rule is a COMPARISON ARM only
C9_role_of_the_threshold_rule.core_question: whether adding task information selects among E, L and F more accurately than the channel alone, and what that does to perception quality and to the QAM-symbol cost
C9_role_of_the_threshold_rule.not_the_question: whether a better threshold exists. A threshold sweep tunes the comparison arm; it does not test the hypothesis

C3_active_E.definition: on cells with q_F >= 0.99 only, a frame is "cooperation is not needed for the task" when Q_E >= max(Q_L, Q_F) - 1e-09
C3_active_E.excluded: frames where E is chosen because the channel destroyed both messages. Those are a fallback, not a statement about the task, and the q_F restriction is what removes them
C3_active_E.status: CONSTRUCTIVE AND PENDING REVIEW. It is a definition being proposed, not a measured property, and no claim rests on it until it is accepted
C3_active_E.caveat: two of the clean cells (AWGN 14 dB and 18 dB) have no channel sample of their own; the definition should be evaluated on the four cells that do
